component: Panorama public facade names and native receiver contracts

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The renamed folderDB/messageDB attributes expose nsIFolderDatabase/nsIMessageDatabase interfaces covering both primary and property tables. Their generated C++ getters return addrefed interfaces; separate concrete native helpers borrow database references. The shared JS fixture reads those named properties after account-manager service setup and clears its references in cleanup. This API rename changes callers and documentation, not stored schema or test expectations. Local variables called folders/messages do not imply the old public property names remain, and this is not a project-wide suffix rule. No interface, schema, cleanup or test execution ran.
title: Panorama folderDB and messageDB name service facades rather than row collections
